fitLegend.equivalent: A creature type that directly matches the Draw Steel monster's general kind (not necessarily its exact depiction).
fitLegend.analogue: A visually or thematically plausible substitute from another system; not an exact Draw Steel depiction.
fitLegend.null: No sufficiently defensible assignment in this first pass.

reviewNotes.methodology: Manually chosen categories by monster lore, ancestry, abilities and role; filenames selected using role/race filters and deterministic per-monster variants. A limited set of galleries was visually sampled; NOT every selected image was visually examined.
reviewNotes.copyright: Too Many Tokens repositories show MIT license files; verify artwork redistribution terms before public hosting. MCDM Draw Steel artwork is not included.
reviewNotes.usage: For an entry [system, category, filename, fit], image URL = imageSources[system] + encodeURIComponent(category) + '/' + encodeURIComponent(filename). The full lookup key = keyPrefix + entry key.
